summary.en: Coming up: at 20 you join the National Pension and the Japan Pension Service sends a notice (not if you are in an employee pension or a dependent spouse). If it has not arrived about 2 weeks after your 20th birthday, apply at your ward office or a pension office. Students (gakusei nofu tokurei) and people with low income can apply to defer or be exempted (to be checked).

text.en: If the notice has not arrived about 2 weeks after you turn 20, apply at your ward office or a nearby pension office. People who came from abroad also receive the notice when they turn 20. If you came to Japan at 20 or older, you join National Pension at the ward office when you register your address.

text.en: Students cannot use the regular exemption; they use the Student Payment Special Measure (gakusei nofu tokurei). Approved months count toward the pension eligibility period, but do not raise your pension unless you pay them back within 10 years. A Japanese-language school qualifies only if it is on the Japan Pension Service school list. Others (non-students, or students of a school not on the list) ask at the counter which exemption applies. Bring: the application form, a certificate of enrolment or a copy of your student ID, and your pension number or My Number Card (to be checked).
